summary: Frontend-only E2E of Phase 6 Pharmacy Marketplace as Omar (patient). All 10 acceptance flows pass. (1) nav-pharmacy link is present and opens /pharmacy (pharmacy-page renders). (2) refills-due leads the page: Concor '4 days left · runs out 2026-08-24 · 100% adherence' rendered in forest (>3 day threshold), and 'Coming up' shows 'Glucophage · 30 days left'. (3) Concor offers show Nahdi FIRST with SPONSORED badge at 42.5 SAR (SFDA-PH-DEMO-100241) and Al Dawaa SECOND at 39.95 SAR (SFDA-PH-DEMO-100987) even though Al Dawaa is cheaper — sponsored-first ordering confirmed. (4) Reorder on the Al Dawaa Concor offer opens the cart drawer with cart-pharmacy line (SFDA/MOH/CR all shown), prescription-block visible, cart-violation 'This order contains prescription medicines. Attach a prescription…', and Checkout button is DISABLED. (5) Controlled: searching 'Tramal' shows 1 card with controlled-badge 'In-store only' + controlled-notice; no add-to-cart button on that card. (6) OTC/in_app flow (from a previous run in the seeded environment) — Al Dawaa Panadol Extra order visible on /pharmacy/orders with status 'Confirmed by the pharmacy', licence line, timeline and working Cancel button. Verified Cancel end-to-end this run: cancelling the Al Dawaa Concor order flipped status to 'Cancelled'. (7) Handoff Nahdi flow: added Nahdi Panadol Extra, checkout button label read 'Continue at Nahdi Pharmacy', clicking it opened a new popup (chrome-error as expected — partner.nahdi.example is a demo host), redirected to /pharmacy/orders where the newest order shows 'Handed to the pharmacy', SFDA/MOH/CR line, an Open at the pharmacy handoff link and NO cancel button. (8) Prescription upload: uploaded a small PNG via prescription-upload-input, checkout eventually proceeded and the resulting Al Dawaa order showed 'Waiting on the pharmacist' + licence line + timeline. (9) Category filters otc/device/supplement all switch the grid (14/9/12 items respectively); every card carries English + Arabic name and item-pharmacy line with SFDA/MOH/CR. Partner pharmacies section renders both partners with licences and 3 working branch-directions links. (10) Medications page 'Add Medication' has all three new fields (med-input-quantity, med-input-units-per-dose, med-input-dispensed-on) and saving a med with quantity 30, units-per-dose 1, dispensed_on today succeeded with no errors. Regression: patient /dashboard, /chat, /visits load with 0 console errors; doctor /doctor (h1 'Good day, Haddad') and /doctor/schedule (h1 'Schedule') load with 0 errors after auth/clinician login.
critical_code_review_comments: CartDrawer.jsx `checkout` toast fallback uses `e?.response?.data?.detail` which will be an object when the backend returns {violations:[...]} — the else-branch renders 'Checkout failed', fine, but if the backend ever returns a plain string detail (e.g. 500) it will still be OK. Consider unifying with PharmacyOrders.jsx `cancel` toast which passes the object to toast.error and would render '[object Object]' if detail is not a string. Minor.

PharmacyOrders.jsx LABEL map still contains delivery-era statuses (preparing/out_for_delivery/delivered) even though the product statement says there is NO delivery at all. Dead labels — not a bug, but a small tidy-up to keep the code aligned with the 'no delivery' rule.

CartDrawer.jsx `prescription-select` briefly still shows 'No prescription attached' immediately after upload because the useEffect that reloads prescriptions is keyed on `cart?.prescription_id` and depends on reload() completing first. In practice the state settles within ~1s and checkout works, but a `setPrescriptions(prev => [...prev, data])` right after upload would eliminate the flicker.

Pharmacy.jsx uses category key '' with data-testid='category-all' — fine, but the checkout success toast message differs between OTC ('Order confirmed with the pharmacy') and the label shown on /orders ('Confirmed by the pharmacy'). Not a bug, just inconsistent phrasing patients may notice.
